instruction: Create an ORIGINAL PURE-DART reusable package named aivexus_index_positions, Dart SDK >=3.3.0 <4.0.0. Implement exactly this PUBLIC TOP-LEVEL Dart function in lib/index_positions.dart: Map<int, List<int>> groupIndices(List<int> input). Map each distinct signed integer to a NEW ordered list of zero-based positions where it appears, with keys in first-appearance order. Empty list gives empty map; do not mutate input. Fully implement working behavior yourself, not a stub. Write reasonable tests under test/. You may use Dart core List, Map, Set, loops and standard library methods only. No third-party runtime dependencies, networking, filesystem, FFI, shell or privileged APIs. Always use valid Dart SDK APIs and compileable types. Return the strict JSON source object requested by the system prompt.
